method.name: count
method.shortdesc: Displays the number of elements in the Endnote.

method.name: item
method.shortdesc: Returns the Endnote with the specified index or name.

parameter.name: index
parameter.shortdesc: The index or name. Can accept: Long Integer or String.

method.name: itemByName
method.shortdesc: Returns the Endnote with the specified name.

method.name: itemByID
method.shortdesc: Returns the Endnote with the specified ID.

method.name: itemByRange
method.shortdesc: Returns the Endnotes within the specified range.

parameter.name: from
parameter.shortdesc: The Endnote, index, or name at the beginning of the range. Can accept: Endnote, Long Integer or String.

parameter.name: to
parameter.shortdesc: The Endnote, index, or name at the end of the range. Can accept: Endnote, Long Integer or String.

method.name: firstItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the first Endnote in the collection.

method.name: lastItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the last Endnote in the collection.

method.name: middleItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the middle Endnote in the collection.

method.name: previousItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the Endnote with the index previous to the specified index.

parameter.name: obj
parameter.shortdesc: The index of the Endnote that follows the desired Endnote.

method.name: nextItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the Endnote whose index follows the specified Endnote in the collection.

parameter.name: obj
parameter.shortdesc: The Endnote whose index comes before the desired Endnote.

method.name: anyItem
method.shortdesc: Returns any Endnote in the collection.

method.name: everyItem
method.shortdesc: Returns every Endnote in the collection.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the Endnote.
Returns the Endnote with the specified index.

property.name: length
property.shortdesc: The number of objects in the collection.
